end.summary:
- Food miles: practised easy questions about a food’s journey from farm to plate; why/new-situation questions remain to check.
- Compared distances using addition and identified that farther foods generally use more fuel and create more pollution; this was not steady yet.
- Practised effects of refrigeration and plastic packaging on energy and cost; reducing food miles was not steady yet.
- The idea that imported food is automatically better or that the source does not matter remained mixed up at the end.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised tracing food from the farm to the plate, comparing distances, and linking longer journeys with more fuel, pollution, refrigeration, and packaging. They used the local May mango example to connect shorter journeys with freshness, lower cost, and fewer food miles. The mix-up that imported food is automatically special or better, and that the farm’s location does not matter, was not corrected by the last time it appeared. At home, ask Rohan to compare two foods in the kitchen by asking where each came from, which travelled farther, and one likely effect of that journey.

Pradushan matlab hawa mein milne wala dhuaan. Agar ek truck dukaan tak das kilometre chale aur doosra sau kilometre, toh kis truck mein zyada indhan jalne ki sambhavna hai?
door wale angoor special hote hain na, isliye unka truck accha chalega aur dhuaan zyada accha hoga. nahi pata bas zyada hoga kyunki door hai

Aap soch rahe hain ki special angoor ka dhuaan bhi achha hoga; lekin dhuaan truck mein jalte indhan se nikalta hai, angoor ke swaad se nahin. Ab aam ka mausam sochiye: May mein paas ki mandi ke aam aur December mein door se aaye aam mein kaunse mausami hain, aur unka ek fayda kya hai?
may wale aam local hain na, mandi ke paas se. toh woh fresh aate hain, saste bhi hote hain, aur... haan, unme food miles bhi kam hain. december wale door se aate hain.

May wale aam paas ke hain aur unke food miles kam hain. Aapne May ke aam ko mausami kehna baaki chhod diya; is tulna mein wahi mausami hain. Ab door se aaye December ke aam ko taaza rakhne ke liye safar mein kya chahiye ho sakta hai, aur usse kya badhega?
pata hai, unhe thanda rakhna padta hai, jaise freeze wali gaadi chahiye, aur alag se plastic packing. isse bijli aur paisa zyada lagta hai.
Ek aur baat: lamba safar karne wali gaadi zyada indhan jalati hai, jisse hawa mein dhuaan bhi badh sakta hai. Ab door ke khaane ke safar se hone wali do samasyaayein kya hain?
zyada indhan jalega aur hawa mein zyada dhuaan hoga, aur phir taaza bhi nahi rahega
Taazgi kam ho sakti hai, par thandi gaadi se use bachaya bhi ja sakta hai. Ab sochiye, paas ka aur door ka khaana dukaan tak pahunchta hai: dono ka poora safar jaanne ke liye hum kya pata karenge?
